g:structured_title.g:content: My Message Matters - Speech & Communication 101 - English PDF ebook

g:structured_description.g:content:
My Message Matters is the Speech & Communication 101 illustrated parent guide from Pinnacle Blooms Network, by Dr. Koti Reddy Saripalli and Dr. Sreeja Reddy Saripalli. Its 31 core pages explore everyday communication through gestures, sounds, words, pictures and established augmentative and alternative communication (AAC).
Explore familiar play, real choices, comfortable response time, shared books, family languages and useful messages such as help, stop, more and finished. The emphasis is on responding to meaning and keeping communication available, including established augmentative and alternative communication (AAC).
For parents and caregivers looking for speech and language support ideas to discuss and share in everyday routines, including families supporting a child with speech delay or different communication needs.
The English PDF contains 45 file pages: 31 core learning pages, nine shared PinnacleAI and Verify information pages, one discipline-specific service page, two covers and two blank pages. 101 is an introductory volume label, not a count of activities. Designed for adult-guided sharing; select ideas to suit the child’s development, comfort and access. General educational information; individual professional advice may be needed. The book purchase does not include therapy, assessment or software access. The PDF edition is prepared. Online purchase and delivery are not yet available.

g:structured_description.g:content:
I Belong in Everyday Life is the Occupational Therapy 101 illustrated parent guide from Pinnacle Blooms Network, by Dr. Koti Reddy Saripalli and Dr. Sreeja Reddy Saripalli. Its 31 core pages explore comfortable access, meaningful everyday roles and different ways for a child to take part.
Explore comfortable access, suitable play materials, stable setups, dressing choices, washing steps, mealtime roles and supported breaks. Notice the child’s preferences, offer practical help and adjust the surroundings before adding demands.
For parents and caregivers seeking practical ways to support play, dressing, washing and daily routines, including families navigating sensory preferences, motor differences or developmental support needs.

g:structured_title.g:content: Understanding Everyday Behaviour - ABA Parent Education 101 - English PDF ebook

g:structured_description.g:content:
Understanding Everyday Behaviour is the ABA Parent Education 101 illustrated guide from Pinnacle Blooms Network, by Dr. Koti Reddy Saripalli and Dr. Sreeja Reddy Saripalli. Its 31 core pages help adults notice communication, comfort, choices and the surrounding situation before deciding how to respond.
Explore genuine choices, useful cues, manageable transitions, response time, supported breaks and ways to ask what would help. The pages welcome the child’s perspective and show practical ways to offer support without turning every moment into a test.
For parents and caregivers seeking a thoughtful introduction to supportive responses, everyday observations and manageable routines, including families supporting autistic children or children with different developmental needs.

g:structured_title.g:content: Learning Through Everyday Play - Special Education 101 - English PDF ebook

g:structured_description.g:content:
Learning Through Everyday Play is the Special Education 101 illustrated parent and educator guide from Pinnacle Blooms Network, by Dr. Koti Reddy Saripalli and Dr. Sreeja Reddy Saripalli. Its 31 core pages explore accessible early learning through familiar objects, stories, choices and shared play.
Share accessible ideas for cause and effect, matching, position, simple quantities, shapes, patterns, pretend play, books and making marks. Welcome watching, choosing, directing and trying, with suitable materials and adult support.
For parents, caregivers and educators looking for inclusive early-learning ideas, including families supporting a child with developmental delay or different learning and participation needs.
